name: PatientTriage.ai - Risk Engine Prototype
status: PROTOTYPE - NOT VALIDATED FOR REAL CLINICAL USE
data_source: 100% synthetic data generated for this prototype. No real patient data was used.
intended_use: Decision-support demonstration for the Accenture Innovation Challenge. Final triage authority remains with a clinician.
known_limitations: Ground-truth labels are simulated and do not represent real clinical outcomes.
Reported metrics measure performance on synthetic labels only.
Safety-rule thresholds are illustrative and have not been clinically validated.
Symptom severity uses a keyword-based text feature rather than a validated clinical NLP system.
No real EHR, hospital, or live-monitor integration exists.
The prototype must not be used for real clinical triage.

model_selection.selection_basis: XGBoost provided the strongest overall discrimination and probability quality among the candidate models.
